note: Set B is better because it avoids the semantic error found in Set A, where Claim 1 incorrectly identifies the bend condition as 'longitude' instead of 'longitudinal' (text: 'longitudinal section'). Set B also provides a more contextually appropriate entity binding for the solar altitude claim ('Harvest Shade Screen') in Claim 4, although it redundantly includes the variable-based claim in Claim 7. Both sets suffer from unnecessary duplication (e.g., shape claims in both, solar altitude in B, bend in A), but Set A's factual misread makes it inferior.
